cards.beat: Primer tramo abierto. El pez pasa un Normalillo que patrulla y gira al extremo de su ruta.
lyrics: He was a lonely boy
Who felt lost
In his own thoughts.
He thought he'd always feel that way,
Until a “light” appeared before him.

cards.beat: Refugio de Chicken. Chicken alterna reposo. El pez cruza por los faroles y uno se ilumina al pasar.
lyrics: The two of them talked for a long time.
He longed for her love.
To him, she was the most beautiful person in the world.
She was the one for him.
He truly loved her.

cards.beat: Refugio de Flower. El pez rodea el claro y el guardián recorre un tramo corto. Flower permanece junto al remedio.
lyrics: But she began to change.
She was no longer the person she'd been.
Little by little, he noticed.
He began to doubt, but he trusted her,
Because he loved her with all his heart.

cards.beat: Refugio de Spiky. El pez pasa de una cobertura a otra. Mostrar un proyectil que recorre una línea despejada.
lyrics: She would find other people
While he sank into misery and despair.
He fought for so long to win her approval.
But in the middle of it all,
He was left betrayed and abandoned.

cards.beat: Tercera zona principal. Picarón persigue dentro de su sector, anticipa un ataque y el pez se aparta.
lyrics: He did all he could to love her,
To keep them together.
He tore out his heart just for her,
But she never answered
And left without ever saying goodbye.

cards.beat: Refugio de Pump. El pez avanza entre macetas y corta uno de los amarres con una pose de ataque.
lyrics: None of his efforts had been worth it.
She had already left him.
He had no one.
He was left alone.
He felt alone.

cards.beat: Refugio de Ghost. El pez pasa por el pedestal y tres marcas se encienden en secuencia.
lyrics: For so long, he felt cast out,
Walking endlessly in search of meaning.
Finding nothing, he felt his soul break more and more.
In pieces, he kept walking,
Hurting with every step he took.

cards.beat: Refugio de Hongui. Un Picarón anuncia el golpe y el pez lo bloquea mirando al atacante.
lyrics: He clung to the idea of a happy life,
Though there was nothing happy about it.
He was only fooling himself,
Trying to believe he was the happiest of all,
Just to feel that life was worth living.

cards.beat: Quinta zona principal. Sharky prepara y atraviesa un carril, y el pez lo esquiva lateralmente.
lyrics: His past pursued him without rest.
It haunted him wherever he went.
He grew tired of it all and gave up on the future,
Because nothing made sense to him anymore.
He was only living for the sake of living.

cards.beat: Refugio de Handy. El pez golpea un cerrojo con Rocky, con la animación del equipo original.
lyrics: And yet something inside him
Still beat so strongly.
His resolve and the courage to go on
Stayed with him and kept him alive,
Because he simply wanted to live.

cards.beat: Refugio de Ic. El pez se desliza hasta una marca y se detiene en la piedra rugosa.
lyrics: I wanted a good life,
A life filled with happiness.
I wanted things to get better.
And you were there beside me.
You watched me grow.
You watched me suffer.
You watched me laugh.

cards.beat: Templo de la séptima zona. Planta señala y extiende una liana. El pez sale del carril antes del contacto.
lyrics: You were always there
When I felt low.
I'll never forget anything about you.
I'll never forget what you meant to me.
I'll never forget my memories of you.

cards.beat: Mercado. El pez se acerca al mostrador y TV enciende su pantalla. La toma mantiene la vista en el mercado.
lyrics: Thank you for being here.
I promise I'll keep
The promise I made to you so long ago.
I'll honor your name.
I'll honor your memory,
Because I loved you so much.

cards.beat: Fosa final. Mostrar la pose de aviso y un barrido claro de God Fish, con el pez a distancia. Cerrar con el ojo visible.
lyrics: I'll never forget…
Everything you were to me…
And the first time I met you…
